failureCasePacks.sourceToDecisionOrSink: HTTP bearer token -> registered Passport BearerStrategy -> Auth.verifyToken(token, done) -> plain-object token lookup -> uid undefined/positive check -> master:true callback.
failureCasePacks.patchDefense: Replace plain-object indexed lookup with strict token equality in Array.find and derive uid only from a found token record.
failureCasePacks.scope: Named inherited-property token lookup defect only, not all authentication or session behavior.
failureCasePacks.confirmedSupportGap: Passport strategy callbacks and prototype-sensitive authorization decisions are not supported by the bounded Express data-flow contracts.
failureCasePacks.unverifiedHypothesis: A framework callback source contract plus typed token lookup/decision evidence may generalize; no such extension is implemented.
failureCasePacks.contextLimit: Selected original files only; bootstrap callers and third-party package implementation are not complete. No runtime reachability proof.

failureCasePacks.independentTruthReview: Pending second curator. Sources are independently published, labels/results are not blinded.
